verdict.taxpayer_mle_note: Confirmed: MIN sits between the first and second apron, so it keeps the taxpayer MLE (~6.065M); a team loses it only ABOVE the second apron. Using it keeps them hard-capped at the second apron, which the aggregation already did, so it adds no new restriction. The binding limit is the ~10.6M of room under the 222M hard cap, which must ALSO cover re-signing RFA Jaylen Clark and the remaining minimum spots. So the realistic toolkit is the taxpayer MLE plus minimums, and even that is room-constrained, not fully deployable. This reinforces the depth constraint; it does not relax it.
verdict.tools_to_fill: taxpayer MLE (6.065M, room-constrained) and minimums; RFA Jaylen Clark; thin at PF
